text: Opening the Subtitles/Graphics <select> shows an empty black popup with no option labels (may be headless native-popup rendering); options can only be chosen blind with arrow keys. Also 'Wake up' stays filled orange while Settings panel is open, so two menu items look selected.
Training lesson 1 'Two Clocks' measures time in 'M' (ping every 10 M, playback 8 M/s, answers 'about 109 M') with no on-screen explanation of what the unit M is.
About is subtitled 'Credits and the physics behind it' but lists no people/credits, only physics notes, references and libraries.
The crosshair brackets draw on top of the 'E Look out of the porthole' prompt text, partly obscuring the words.
Pause > Controls says 'Walk: W A S D or arrows' but Left/Right arrows turn the view; turning on keys is not listed, nor 1/2/3 for answering questions.

With the crosshair dot on the bookshelf, the prompt still reads 'E Look out of the porthole' and the target brackets sit on the porthole far to the left; the use prompt is not tied to what the crosshair is on.

Pause > Main menu returned to title instantly with no confirmation; title shows 'Wake up' again with no Continue, so ~30 s of play (dream + quarters) is discarded. The pause panel does say progress saves at each chapter, but the Main menu button gives no warning.

Quitting to title via Pause > Main menu logs an objective_completed event for 'Go to the bridge' (number 1, tick 2007) although the player never reached the bridge; the next new game then starts that objective as number 2. Probe/telemetry only, not visible on screen.
After reaching chapter I (Beacon K-1) the title shows Continue / New game, but there is no Chapters entry anywhere on the title menu (also none on a fresh save), so chapter select could not be found.
